Seated as `epic:#33595#1` on the maintainer's word 「立专题卡，然后派专题pm」 (2026-11-15, this project's eval seat thread), relayed with the order to run `/pm-dispatch epic:#33595`. No earlier epic seat on this parent: the body carried none and this thread had no comment.

- Body: seat line, exception reason, file territory and the hot-file serial queue written in the "Epic PM seat" section.

## M1 split summary · 2026-11-15T07:35Z

All four M1 children are merged and closed.

| Card | PR(s) | Merge | What the scorer does now |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| #33596 | #33625 | `1e77fef9` | When the agent's write and the runner's probe both get 403 and nothing is written, and the build routes no lock, an `applied` write is **not measured**, with a Build finding. The `write_validation` probe is graded the same way. A hook's own 403 (`declaredCode`) stays measured. |
| #33597 | #33630 + #33707 | `36936440`, `f4458702` | The Build half adds one `persona-grant:<persona>:<object>:<verb>` check per need the card implies. Fork 2 (ii-a) is ruled (6889635350). 13 persona roles now state the writes the build prompt did not, and a TRACE pin holds that for every card. |
| #33598 | #33629 | `3c0033f9` | Numbers inside identifiers (`INV-003`, `i3`) are no longer figures for the answer match or the leak scans. |
| #33599 | #33669 | `f21d980e` | An `unanswerable` question is correct only when the reply declines **and** every number it writes is carried by that turn's tool output (seat ruling C). Accepted cost: an invented number that happens to equal a tool-output number is not caught. |

- **Premise corrections and rulings, all recorded on their cards:** #33596 6887999657 (`pending_confirmation` half dropped); #33597 6888060472 (refused arm) and 6889635350 (fork 2 (ii-a); the round-2 scope); #33599 rule C (seat, in ACCEPT 6889924670).
- **Contract review:** #33625 at the seat (`TIER_DEFAULT`, declaration face); #33630 by review#2 (6889624779, delta 6889866320); #33629 at the seat; #33669 and #33707 have no face.
- **eval#1:** `Notify: landed` sent to #33469 (6890307822). The M1 replay is recorded on `36936440` before the card-role edit (6890573292). The live confirmation runs on the new prompts are next, at eval#1.
- **Found in M1, now M2 rows in the table above:** the `recorded:` driver does not re-send writes on replay (eval#1); `DECLINE` misses "does not record" / "There is no X field" (this seat).
- **Seat errors, corrected:** the claims said `Clause-②: no` for widening PRs (corrected 6888513806 / 6888520066 / 6888527081); a claim correction misnamed `./score` (corrected 6889635350).

**Next:** per this body, the M2/M3 rows are filed on the maintainer's go, into the devx lane queue unless that go reserves them for this seat.

## M3 closed · 2026-11-16T09:04Z

All four M3 children are merged and closed. Each landed after a seat ACCEPT on the card. The three Clause-② widenings also had a seat contract review.

| Card | What it changed | PR · merge |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #34296 | The three control cards carry every text in Chinese, so `--lang zh` runs all three. Each card asks three unanswerable questions, each paired with an answerable twin, and has `avg` / `max` / `min` truths. crm seeds `account.employees`. Question counts move from crm 8 → 14, invoice 9 → 14 and project 8 → 13, so a scorecard from before this change does not compare with one after it. | #34306 · `1c611ece` |
| #34295 | `objectstack-scenarios summary` prints one author-model × ask-model table per card and mode from run records, and refuses tables whose runs differ. Under ruling B, `run --template F` records `template: { file, sha256 }`. | #34310 · `b2e26fe1` |
| #34293 | A `pending_confirmation` operation that asked first gets a second turn, in which the person confirms. The confirmed write is graded against the operation's declared target, and the operation scores only when both turns pass. The scorecard shows `confirmed write k/N`. `AGENT_CONFIRMATION_MEETS_PENDING` stays until cloud#3826 item 6 lands. | #34312 · `951eceee` |
| #34294 | Before each operation, rows an earlier turn moved are restored to the seeded state as the admin, through the seed path. A restore that fails makes the operation NOT MEASURED. A run with no drift is byte-identical. On eval#1's 138 records, 628 of 1,290 operations ran after an earlier write; 1 failed row-state grade is the one the restore can plausibly move. An exact count needs a replay. | #34338 · `f59a4aa0` |

**What a close-out run should know:** #34293, #34294 and #34296 move scores. Compare scorecards only within runs made on or after `f59a4aa0`.

**Hand-off:** the eval#1 seat went offline at 07:17Z, and #33468 is vacant. `Notify: landed` is left on eval mailbox #33469 for the next eval seat, which owns the milestone table and any M3 close-out run.

**Still open on this epic:** the M3 row "at least 2 held-out cards in the private overlay" belongs to the overlay owner and is never filed in this repository. That keeps the table incomplete, so this issue stays open.

**Seat:** this seat clocks out on the maintainer's word of 2026-11-16 07:11Z (「其他座位当前任务处理完也可以下班了」). No child card remains `pm:epic` and unstarted. The exception section of this body is marked closed, the patrol is stopped, and mailbox #33602 is closed.
